title: RigorLLM: Resilient Guardrails for Large Language Models against Undesired Content
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a safety guardrail framework (RigorLLM) designed to detect and moderate harmful content and defend against jailbreaking attacks. While it deals with AI safety (which has ethical motivations), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral frameworks beyond standard LLM safety moderation categories.
